index 0: min_val=1, max_val = 23 - (3-1)*10 = 23-20=3. So val in 1..3.
index 1: min_val = val0+10, max_val = 23 - (3-2)*10 = 13.
index 2: min_val = val1+10, max_val = 23 - 0 = 23.

val0=3: val1 from 13 to 13.
 val1=13: val2 23 → 1.

Total = 3+2+1+2+1+1 = 10.
